collection.title: Citroen C4 Hatchback (Not Cactus Model) 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C4 Hatchback 2004 to 2010 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 28" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this C4 Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
